method: Direct visual and textual inspection of fifteen consecutive item bodies in the user-supplied Kehot publisher scan. OCR was used only for navigation and checked against rendered pages; no blocked crawler was used.

verification_scope: Fifteen letter bodies were inspected across PDF pages 370-389. Incoming correspondence, early editions, manuscripts, cited works, ship records, press reports, construction files, employment agreements, school and camp records, financial records and later outcomes were not independently inspected.
rights_note: Only bounded non-verbatim research paraphrases and locators were recorded; no protected letter was copied in full.
quality_note: All propositions are source-grounded paraphrases. Fragmentary items, copy and secretariat status, Yiddish-derived paraphrases, secretary signatures, conditional commitments, health and legal limits, and shared Evidence Families are preserved.
